subject: Data retention alignment — orchestration & temporary log hold request
messages:
From: Gina Torres <gina.torres@healthledger.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: audit-team@healthledger.com, security-scans@thirdparty.net
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention alignment for HealthLedger — backup purge and log exception

Hi Neha,

We're approaching a scheduled backup purge window and the internal audit team has flagged a potential gap between your standard retention cadence and the evidence we need for an upcoming regulatory sampling. Specifically: we need access to detailed request logs and a small set of offsite snapshots covering the period Apr 1 — Jun 30, 2027.

Can Redwood: 1) delay purge of the identified snapshots and associated logs for an additional 90 days (until 2027-09-30) as an exception; 2) provide a short runbook describing how those snapshots will be isolated and how you will ensure no new retention policy inadvertently removes artifacts; and 3) confirm subprocessors that will touch backups/snapshots for this tenant.

If an amendment to the DPA is required for the temporary hold, please point us to the DocuSign draft and an expected timeline for signatures. We've attached a brief audit request (HealthLedger_Audit_Request.pdf) with the sample list.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement and an ETA on a mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Gina Torres
Compliance Program Manager
HealthLedger

Attachments: HealthLedger_Audit_Request.pdf
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina.torres@healthledger.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention alignment for HealthLedger — backup purge and log exception

Hi Gina — thanks for the details and the audit packet. Acknowledged.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- We can provisionally isolate the named snapshots and place them in a short-term hold cohort; purge will be deferred for 90 days (target retain-until: 2027-09-30).
- We will prepare a short runbook showing the isolation path (offsite bucket + access controls) and the purge gating checks.
- If the legal team requires a formal DPA amendment for the temporary exception, we'll route the DPA amendment draft via DocuSign and aim for signatures within 7 business days.

I'll loop in Kim and Marcus to confirm operational feasibility and whether we need an internal log-retention whitelist for this tenant. Can you confirm which subprocessor(s) HealthLedger is concerned about (if any) and whether the snapshot metadata contains any cross-border transfer considerations?

I'll follow up with a proposed runbook + DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy & Trust Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Data retention alignment for HealthLedger — operational plan needed

Kim / Marcus — forwarding HealthLedger's ask. Key asks: 90-day hold on specific snapshots/logs and a short runbook describing isolation and purge gating. Legal may require a DPA amendment.

Operational options (quick assessment):
- Option A (recommended): Create a temporary retention cohort ID HL-AUDIT-202706, copy identified snapshots into an offsite, immutable bucket (read-only, access via ticket), mark original snapshots with a 'hold' tag so purge pipeline skips them. Minimal runtime impact.
- Option B: Pause the global purge job for the tenant window. Higher blast radius; needs strong pre- and post-checks.

Runbook items we need to produce:
- Exact object list and IDs (HealthLedger to confirm)
- Copy + verify steps for offsite bucket (s3://redwood-archive-offsite/hl-audit-202706)
- ACL and IAM ticketing flow for temporary access
- Purge gating: automated guard that checks 'hold' tags and does not remove held objects
- Expiration step to release cohort on 2027-09-30 unless extension approved

Attachments: proposed-exception-runbook.md (draft) — contains a procedural checklist; email-draft-to-healthledger.txt — suggested messaging to the customer.

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm capacity and ETA for offsite copy (target: 24–48 hours).
- Kim: confirm if Legal needs a DPA amendment for a time-limited hold and prep DocuSign draft (cc Rishi).
- Rishi: flag any compliance/regulatory constraints for keeping logs beyond standard retention for this customer/region.

Please update the attached runbook draft inline and I'll send the final customer message after legal confirmation.

Thanks — Neha

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Gina Torres <gina.torres@healthledger.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention alignment for HealthLedger — orchestration & temporary log hold request

Hi Gina — quick update and plan we can execute immediately upon your confirmation below.

Agreed temporary plan (summary):
- Scope: snapshots and request logs covering Apr 1 — Jun 30, 2027 (per your packet).
- Hold duration: 90 days; retention hold expiration set to 2027-09-30 23:59:59 UTC.
- Isolation: objects will be copied to an offsite, immutable bucket (hl-audit-202706) and marked with cohort ID HL-AUDIT-202706. The active purge pipeline will skip objects with the 'hl-exception-hold' tag.
- Access: read-only access via a ticket to your audit team; access logs for the held objects will be retained.
- Subprocessors: Current subprocessors that may touch backups/snapshots are listed in the DPA appendix (we will include an export in the DocuSign amendment).

Next steps for signatures & evidence:
1) We will send a brief DPA amendment (time-limited exception) via DocuSign — draft is available here: https://app.docusign.com/documents/3a7f-HealthLedger-DPA-Draft
2) Please confirm the object ID list (or provide the CSV in reply) and a point of contact for access requests.
3) Once we receive confirmation, Marcus's team will copy objects to the offsite bucket (ETA 24–48 hours) and we will confirm via a ticket.

Attachments: proposed-exception-runbook.md (finalized), DPA_amendment_draft.docx

If that aligns with HealthLedger's audit timeline, reply with a confirmation and the object list and we'll start the operational steps immediately.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy & Trust Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
